_readme: Single source for business details, placeholders and feature switches. Empty string = not yet known: the site shows '[To be confirmed]' or hides the item. Never invent values here.

forms._help: mode 'email' opens the visitor's email app with the enquiry addressed to contact.email; delivery is never claimed. Set mode to 'live' AND a real endpoint (Formspree, Netlify Forms, custom API) to submit directly; success is shown only when the endpoint returns success.

analytics._help: Leave empty to load no analytics. When set, GA4 loads only after the visitor accepts analytics cookies.

fullyManaged.spendingCeiling: A spending ceiling is agreed in writing. Routine repairs up to that ceiling are ordered without asking you first.
fullyManaged.reserve: Any rent reserve held back for repairs is agreed in writing and shown on every statement.
fullyManaged.majorWorksRule: Major works above the ceiling are never ordered without your approval, except to make a property safe.

limitedManagement.approvalChannel: We ask for your approval by your preferred contact route, and record your answer against the job.
limitedManagement.landlordResponseWindow: A response window for each type of job is agreed in your management agreement.
limitedManagement.noReplyRule: If we do not hear back, we chase you and escalate. Work other than making a property safe does not start without your permission.

standard24h.clockStarts: From the moment GETLET receives and logs the report.
standard24h.emergencyVsRoutine: Emergencies are escalated immediately and the property is made safe first. Routine repairs are acknowledged, assessed and scheduled.
standard24h.propertyAccess: Time spent arranging access with the tenant is not counted as contractor delay.
standard24h.partsDelays: If a part has to be ordered, we agree a revised plan with you and keep the tenant informed.
standard24h.landlordApprovalTime: In Limited Management the time taken to give approval sits outside our control and extends the timeline.
standard24h.escalation: Jobs that miss the standard are escalated to a senior member of the team and the reason is recorded.

payments.paymentTiming: Payment dates are set out in your management agreement and shown on every statement.
payments.insufficientFunds: If rent has not arrived, or does not cover an invoice, the shortfall is shown on your statement, carried forward and explained to you.
payments.clientMoneyProtection: The client money protection arrangements that apply to your agreement are set out in your written terms of business.
payments.redressScheme: Details of the redress scheme that applies to your agreement are set out in your written terms of business.

fees.managementCharge: Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT. The quotation states whether it applies to rent due or rent collected.

operations.referencing: Referencing, deposit protection and tenancy agreements are covered in your written management agreement.
operations.depositProtection: Covered in your written management agreement.
operations.tenancyAgreements: Covered in your written management agreement.
operations.certificationAgencies: Gas and electrical certificates are arranged through specialist partner agencies.
operations.contractorTrades: Plumbing, heating, electrical and general repairs.
operations.outOfHours: Out-of-hours reports follow the emergency route on this page, and the arrangements for each plan are set out in your management agreement.
